items.title: Glarity
items.summary: Adds AI summaries next to Google results and on YouTube videos, web pages and PDFs, with translation and questions about the page you are on. Its code is open source.

items.title: YouTube Summary with ChatGPT & Claude
items.summary: Summarises YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs and offers the video transcript when one exists, using several AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral and Gemini.

items.title: Mouse Tooltip Translator
items.summary: Translates text when you hover over it, including text in PDFs and images (OCR), and shows dual subtitles on YouTube and Netflix. Translation is done by Google Translate and Bing.

items.title: Writely
items.summary: A writing helper that brings AI drafting, translation and reading support to editor pages across the web, in the spirit of Notion AI. It is marked as a beta.
